name: kensho-sweep-mcp
title: Kensho Japan X/Twitter Sweepstakes MCP
description: Read-only MCP server exposing the kensho Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes dataset (1133 campaigns from knshow.com, kenshou.club, ken-kaku.com, cp.meikan.org). Three tools: current_sweep, sweep_history, top_prize_movers. No input required, no API key, no network.

input.title: Input schema for kensho-sweep-mcp
input.description: kensho-sweep-mcp is a read-only MCP server. It requires no input parameters — start it and connect an MCP client (e.g. via the Apify MCP integration or Smithery) to discover its tools: current_sweep, sweep_history, top_prize_movers. All data is bundled locally; no network, no API key, no account.

output.title: Output schema of kensho-sweep-mcp
output.description: kensho-sweep-mcp exposes a Streamable HTTP MCP server on the Apify standby container (APIFY_CONTAINER_PORT). It produces no dataset or key-value store output; its result is the MCP tool interface itself. Connect an MCP client to the standby URL and call current_sweep, sweep_history, or top_prize_movers.
